result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: the metadata line under Tokumaru Ramen Bar has overlapping, garbled text where the delivery time collides with the delivery-fee label.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the subtitle beneath 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' renders as garbled overlapping text reading '25-30delivery · Ramen'. The delivery-time text (e.g. '25-30 min') collides with the delivery-fee text, so 'min' is obscured and the line is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the time, fee, and cuisine as separate non-overlapping inline elements with consistent spacing (e.g. '25-30 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'), and constrain or wrap the line so it cannot overflow into adjacent text on narrow widths.
